papers.title: Navigation sensors and systems in GNSS degraded and denied environments
papers.potential_relevance: GNSS 退化/拒止领域的经典综述（Draper Lab），梳理 GPS/惯性/其他辅助传感器与组合技术的进展，可为比赛技术方案的退化应对章节提供框架性引用。
papers.verification_evidence: OpenAlex API (https://api.openalex.org/works?search=GNSS%20denied%20navigation) 返回该记录：标题、2014 年、DOI 10.1016/j.cja.2014.12.001、期刊 Chinese Journal of Aeronautics，并还原出完整摘要（综述性质，提及 Bluefin-21 系统等）。
papers.notes: 综述文章，本身无实验数字；用于背景与分类。

papers.title: Shadow Matching: A New GNSS Positioning Technique for Urban Canyons
papers.potential_relevance: 提出利用 3D 建筑模型预测卫星可见性做 shadow matching，改善城市峡谷横向（cross-street）定位；是 3DMA-GNSS 路线的奠基文献，支撑本项目在遮挡环境用环境先验改善 GNSS 的思路。
papers.verification_evidence: OpenAlex API (https://api.openalex.org/works?search=GNSS%20urban%20canyon%20positioning 及 doi:10.1017/s0373463311000087 记录) 返回标题、2011 年、期刊 Journal of Navigation 与完整摘要；摘要明确基于建模（modelling）演示该方法潜力。

performance_data.metric: cross-street positioning accuracy (potential, modelled)
performance_data.conditions: 城市峡谷建模仿真：用 3D 建筑模型预测卫星可见性并与实测可见性比对定位；非实车实验
performance_data.snippet: Modelling is used to show that this shadow matching technique has the potential to achieve metre-order cross-street positioning in urban canyons.

papers.notes: 摘要中同时指出：多星座可提升沿街方向精度但横向精度仍差（建筑遮挡导致信号沿街传播）。

papers.title: Height Aiding, C/N0 Weighting and Consistency Checking for GNSS NLOS and Multipath Mitigation in Urban Areas
papers.potential_relevance: 与本项目『退化时降权/拒绝观测』设计最直接相关：无额外硬件条件下比较高度辅助、C/N0 加权、一致性检验三种手段在伦敦市中心的实测效果，并警示盲目剔除观测可能适得其反。
papers.verification_evidence: OpenAlex API (https://api.openalex.org/works?filter=doi:... 多条批量抓取) 返回该 DOI 的完整摘要（abstract_inverted_index 还原），摘要含 35%/4 倍/8%/60% 等数字与 central London 多点实测描述。

performance_data.metric: horizontal accuracy improvement from terrain-height aiding
performance_data.conditions: 英国伦敦市中心多地点实测数据、多星座 GNSS 单点定位、无额外硬件
performance_data.snippet: Aiding the position solution using a terrain height database was found to have the biggest impact, improving the horizontal accuracy by 35% and the vertical accuracy by a factor of 4.

performance_data.metric: vertical accuracy improvement from terrain-height aiding
performance_data.conditions: 同上：伦敦市中心实测、terrain height 数据库辅助
performance_data.snippet: improving the horizontal accuracy by 35% and the vertical accuracy by a factor of 4

performance_data.metric: horizontal accuracy improvement from C/N0-based measurement weighting
performance_data.conditions: 伦敦市中心实测；按载噪比 C/N0 对 GNSS 观测加权
performance_data.snippet: An 8% improvement in horizontal accuracy was also obtained from weighting the GNSS measurements in the position solution according to the carrier-power-to-noise-density ratio (C/N0).

performance_data.metric: horizontal accuracy degradation from conventional sequential consistency checking (wrong-exclusion risk)
performance_data.conditions: 伦敦市中心实测；常规顺序剔除法在多信号同时受 NLOS/多路径影响时常剔除错误观测
performance_data.snippet: Consistency checking using a conventional sequential elimination technique was found to degrade horizontal positioning performance by 60% because it often eliminated the wrong measurements in cases when multiple signals were affected by NLOS reception or strong multipath interference.

papers.notes: 对项目设计的核心启示：退化观测宜『先降权、谨慎硬剔除』；子集比较式一致性检查优于常规顺序剔除但仍不稳定。

papers.title: Measuring GNSS Multipath Distributions in Urban Canyon Environments
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement
papers.potential_relevance: 实测刻画城市峡谷多路径误差分布（多普勒/码相位时延随车速与信号功率的变化及方向依赖性），为本项目理解退化观测的统计特性提供依据。
papers.verification_evidence: OpenAlex API (https://api.openalex.org/works?search=GNSS%20urban%20canyon%20positioning) 返回该记录：标题、2014 年、DOI、期刊 IEEE TIM 及完整摘要（含 multipath directional-dependence 现象描述）。
papers.notes: 摘要为误差特性测量与建模，无归纳性的精度提升数字。

papers.title: LiDAR Scan Matching Aided Inertial Navigation System in GNSS-Denied Environments
papers.potential_relevance: GNSS 拒止时用低成本 LiDAR 扫描匹配辅助 INS 的松组合 EKF 方案，并在自研轮式 UGV 平台（NAVIS）实测验证，与本项目轮式平台退化备份 directly 相关。
papers.verification_evidence: OpenAlex API (https://api.openalex.org/works?search=GNSS%20denied%20navigation 与批量 DOI 抓取) 返回标题、2015 年、DOI 10.3390/s150716710、期刊 Sensors 与完整摘要（含 UGV NAVIS 实测描述）。

performance_data.metric: long-term positioning accuracy in GNSS-denied environment
performance_data.conditions: 自研无人地面车辆（UGV）平台 NAVIS，静态与动态实地测试；INS+LiDAR SLAM 松组合 EKF，含特征缺失环境
performance_data.snippet: The results prove that the proposed approach can provide positioning accuracy at the centimetre level for long-term operations, even in a featureless environment.

papers.notes: 摘要未给出具体厘米数值；作为轮式平台 GNSS 拒止备份方案证据。

papers.title: NLOS Correction/Exclusion for GNSS Measurement Using RAIM and City Building Models
papers.potential_relevance: 3D 建筑模型射线追踪 + RAIM 卫星选择/FDE 剔除 NLOS 观测，直接对应本项目『NLOS 检测→拒绝观测』环节，并给出分环境（中/深峡谷）量化收益。
papers.verification_evidence: OpenAlex API (https://api.openalex.org/works?search=GNSS%20NLOS%20detection%20multipath%20urban 与批量 DOI 抓取) 两次返回该记录完整摘要，含 8.4% 与 36.2% 数字及『错侧定位解（wrong side of the road）』指标定义。

performance_data.metric: reduction of large-error positioning solutions (estimated on wrong side of road), middle urban canyon
performance_data.conditions: 3D 建筑模型法 + RAIM 卫星选择；中等城市峡谷环境
performance_data.snippet: the RAIM satellite selection technique can reduce by about 8.4% and 36.2% the positioning solutions with large errors (solutions estimated on the wrong side of the road) for the 3D building model method in the middle and deep urban canyon environment, respectively.

performance_data.metric: reduction of large-error positioning solutions (wrong side of road), deep urban canyon
performance_data.conditions: 同上；深城市峡谷环境；射线追踪假设单次反射，不一致者判为多重反射 NLOS 并剔除
performance_data.snippet: reduce by about 8.4% and 36.2% the positioning solutions with large errors (solutions estimated on the wrong side of the road) for the 3D building model method in the middle and deep urban canyon environment, respectively

papers.notes: 指标定义是『错侧解比例』而非米级误差，使用时注意口径。

papers.verification_evidence: OpenAlex API (https://api.openalex.org/works?search=GNSS%20NLOS%20detection%20multipath%20urban) 返回该记录：标题、2017、DOI 10.1109/itsc.2017.8317700 与完整摘要，摘要含约 75% 分类精度数字。

performance_data.snippet: According to the experiment result, about 75% of classification accuracy can be achieved using a support vector machine (SVM) classifier trained by the proposed feature and received signal strength.

papers.potential_relevance: 在真实城市场景、低成本传感器与大众市场 GNSS 接收机条件下对比松/紧组合相对独立与商用模块的性能，直接支撑本项目选择紧耦合架构的论证。
papers.verification_evidence: OpenAlex API (https://api.openalex.org/works?search=GNSS%20outage%20inertial%20navigation%20drift) 返回该记录：标题、2017 年、DOI 10.3390/s17020255、期刊 Sensors 与完整摘要（真实城市场景测试描述）。
papers.notes: 摘要未给具体数字；结论为紧组合（低成本器件）相较 standalone 与松组合有性能提升。

papers.potential_relevance: GNSS 失效期间用 RNN 估计 INS 误差（利用 INS 计算原理+RNN 记忆特性），给出与 ELM/EKF 的相对提升幅度，是『GNSS 中断期间纯惯性漂移补偿』的代表性方案。

papers.title: Combined GPS + BDS for short to long baseline RTK positioning
papers.potential_relevance: Perth 实测数据评估 GPS+BDS 短/中/长基线 RTK，结论：双系统组合允许使用高于常规的截止角，对露天矿/城市峡谷等受限视距环境有利——支撑本项目遮挡场景剔除低质观测的策略。

papers.verification_evidence: OpenAlex API（批量 DOI 抓取）返回完整摘要，含 62.8%/72.3%/52.1% 与 62.1% 数字及『mimic two-minute GNSS outages』『Land vehicle tests in open-sky areas and tunnel cases』条件。

performance_data.metric: max position drift RMS reduction during 2-min GNSS outages (north/east/up) vs GNSS/INS/ODO
performance_data.conditions: 开阔地与隧道车载实测；模拟 2 分钟 GNSS 中断；对比常规 GNSS/INS/ODO 组合
performance_data.snippet: During the navigation drift evaluation of the mimic two-minute GNSS outages, compared to the conventional GNSS/INS (inertial navigation system)/ODO integration, the root mean square (RMS) of the maximum position drift errors during outages in the proposed navigation system were reduced by 62.8%, 72.3%, and 52.1%, along the north, east, and height, respectively.

performance_data.metric: yaw error reduction during outages vs GNSS/INS/ODO
performance_data.conditions: 同上：模拟 2 分钟 GNSS 中断，车载实测
performance_data.snippet: Moreover, the yaw error was reduced by 62.1%.

papers.notes: 注意是『相对降幅』而非绝对漂移米数；ODO 里程计是轮式平台天然可用传感器。

conflicts.claim: 城市环境下『剔除不一致观测（一致性检验/RAIM FDE）』能否可靠提升水平定位精度
conflicts.paper_a: Groves & Jiang 2013 (Journal of Navigation, 10.1017/s0373463313000350)：常规顺序剔除法使水平精度劣化 60%（伦敦实测）
conflicts.paper_b: Hsu, Gu & Kamijo 2015 (Sensors, 10.3390/s150717329)：3D 建筑模型+RAIM 卫星选择使错侧解减少 8.4%（中等峡谷）/36.2%（深峡谷）
conflicts.explanation: 两者不矛盾但构成设计张力：Groves 2013 中的常规剔除不知道哪颗是 NLOS，多信号同时受污染时经常剔除正确观测并破坏几何；Hsu 2015 用 3D 模型先验判定后再剔除。对项目的含义：退化观测处理应有环境先验或先降权后硬剔除，纯新息阈值剔除在深峡谷不可靠。

conflicts.claim: C/N0 用于退化观测处理的正确用法：连续加权 vs 门槛剔除
conflicts.paper_a: Groves & Jiang 2013：按 C/N0 加权带来水平精度 8% 改善（伦敦实测）
conflicts.paper_b: Kubo et al. 2020 (Sensors, 10.3390/s20144059)：单点仰角相关 C/N0 阈值不足以剔除 NLOS（C/N0 受 NLOS 影响波动大），需连续时间序列判据
conflicts.explanation: 两文互补：C/N0 加权是软处理，收益温和但稳健；硬阈值剔除易误判，需要时间持续性判据。项目可组合：C/N0 加权 + 持续低 C/N0 才降权/拒绝。
